policy: Every published number must name its eval set and provenance. Clean-100 is not an external test set.

sroie_eval.source: SROIE receipt images, original 100-doc project eval
sroie_eval.provenance: original set; 61/100 receipts also appear in the public SROIE train split (perceptual match across two resamplers)
sroie_eval.use: historical paired same-document comparisons only; do not use as a headline or held-out claim

sroie_eval_clean.provenance: 100-doc split carved from the public SROIE train pool after removing duplicates of our 100-doc holdout; duplicate components split wholesale

leakage.note: clean relative to our holdout, not relative to Qwen pretraining; public SROIE may be in the base model's training data

sroie_eval_clean.use: current engine comparisons (Qwen 3B/2B bake-off, hybrid v2); not an external generalization claim

sroie_val.provenance: 40-doc val split from the same filtered public-SROIE pool
sroie_val.use: sanity check only; n=40 is too small to select 1-3 point differences

funsd.provenance: word-level NER labels aggregated into four receipt-shaped keys (company/date/address/total)

leakage.note: public dataset; may be in base-model pretraining

funsd.use: transfer probe only; nonstandard gold mapping, never a leaderboard number

ocrbench_256m_full.provenance: full 1,000-sample evaluation of the retired 256M checkpoint
ocrbench_256m_full.use: retirement evidence only; 0.0% strict accuracy, no performance claim

invoices.blocker: CORD images absent; DocILE access is gated; no invoice manifest yet

docvqa.blocker: images exist, but no manifest/runner is wired into the phase-0 harness

grounding.manifest_note: manifest and images live on the external disk / data/training symlink; regenerate with the same seed if absent
grounding.decision: v3.0 ships OCR-span evidence only; do not claim VLM boxes

confidence.decision: do not present confidence as calibrated or as a probability until Phase 2.4
confidence.path: evidence_off (eval harness; not the SDK default)
confidence.note: constant 0.4025 because attach_evidence=False; measures the eval path, not ReceiptPipeline defaults

evidence_replay.method: attach_evidence_from_preds.py replays OCR/evidence on saved fields

calibration.grouping: document (fields from one document never cross the split)
calibration.scope: out-of-fold on clean-100, not an external test

confidence_evidence_on.decision: field-level confidence is usable for review routing after a dedicated-split fit; document-level confidence is not a probability; isotonic does not reliably improve doc-level calibration
